brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, the School Board appointed Freddie Elswick as interim Northwestern District member on Oct. 30; the Board approved a nine-month data center moratorium. Richlands PD arrested Hunter Brian Gill, 28, of Richlands, on Oct. 26/27 for armed robbery and firearm charges at Big Lots. Mercer County saw early voting turnout and opioid settlement funding for an emergency center roof; Halloween trick-or-treat set for 6-8 p.m. Saturday in several towns. Regionally, McDowell/Wyoming counties conducted a child exploitation sting with four arrests Oct. 29; no active NWS alerts or major road closures reported.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/30/tazewell-county-school-board-appoints-interim-member/)[[2]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/31/tazewell-county-imposes-9-month-data-center-moratorium/)[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/richlands-police-department-announces-arrest-armed-robbery/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core (Tazewell County/Mercer County):**  
Richlands Police Department arrested Hunter Brian Gill, 28, of Richlands, on charges of armed robbery, use of a firearm in the commission of a felony, and brandishing a firearm following an Oct. 26, 2026, incident at Big Lots in Richlands around 3:50 p.m. The suspect allegedly displayed a firearm at the register and fled; Gill was identified and taken into custody with assistance from the Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office and task force.[[3]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/richlands-police-department-announces-arrest-armed-robbery/)[[4]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/tazewell-county-crime/richlands-police-department-asks-public-for-help-identifying-suspect-in-robbery-investigation/)

Mercer County grand jury issued indictments including first-degree murder, concealment of a body, strangulation, and domestic battery against Donald Ray Pennington, 59 (arrested May after a Bluefield woman’s body was found in Bland County); and financial exploitation/fraud charges against Ren Xin Huang, 55, of New York, in a multi-state scam targeting an elderly local victim (sting in Bluefield).[[5]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/23/mercer-county-indictments-include-murder-multi-state-scam/)

Bluefield WV Police Department released a bench warrant list (municipal court warrants for various offenses including DUI, drugs, assault); individuals can turn themselves in at the department.[[6]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-54/)

Tazewell County Sheriff Brian Hieatt issued Halloween safety reminders on reckless driving, vandalism, DUIs, and home security.[[7]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/tazewell-county-sheriff-shares-halloween-safety-tips/)

**Region:** McDowell and Wyoming County sheriffs’ joint Operation Black Lantern (online sting) resulted in four arrests Oct. 29 for suspected child exploitation: Jonathan Rutan, 27, of Ripley; John Beckwith, 44, of Charleston; Austin Cox, 36, of Blountville, TN; and one additional suspect.[[8]](https://wvmetronews.com/2026/10/29/joint-operation-in-mcdowell-and-wyoming-county-nets-suspected-child-predators/)

Nothing else reported in the last 24 hours for core agencies.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
No active NWS alerts. No reported flooding, power outages, or major interstate closures on US-19, US-460, I-77, or I-81 affecting the area. Halloween trick-or-treat hours set for 6-8 p.m. Saturday in Bluefield VA/WV, Princeton, and related towns; various trunk-or-treat and community events scheduled.[[9]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/halloween-activities-off-to-an-early-start-across-mercer-mcdowell-county-region/article_a748dbff-70c9-4959-9d95-5f032131fa3f.html)

**Region:** Bristol District VDOT weekly traffic alert covers Nov. 2-8 work (older item). No severe weather impacts noted.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Tazewell County School Board appointed Freddie Elswick (Richlands High graduate, Ramey Automotive GM, youth sports volunteer) as interim Northwestern District member to replace resigned member Donna Lawson Culbertson; sworn in Oct. 30 by Circuit Court Clerk Charity Hurst.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/30/tazewell-county-school-board-appoints-interim-member/)[[10]](https://x.com/TCPSchools/status/2116164590744543423)

Tazewell County Board of Supervisors unanimously approved a nine-month moratorium on data centers (until July 28, 2027) to develop zoning and standards for setbacks, noise, energy/water use, etc.[[2]](https://www.25newsnow.com/2026/10/31/tazewell-county-imposes-9-month-data-center-moratorium/)

Thousands of Mercer and Tazewell voters participated in early voting ahead of Tuesday’s elections.[[11]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bench-warrant-list-released-by-the-bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-53/) (free lead)

**Region:** WV allocated $2 million in Rural Health Transformation funds to community health centers. Opioid settlement funds to support new roof for Mercer County emergency center.[[12]](https://recentlybooked.com/VA/Tazewell) (free lead)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Renovations underway on Frank Easley Bridge in Bluefield, WV, with completion expected by spring. Bluefield (VA) considering a pump track for city park. Hickam to share “October Sky” story with area students.[[11]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bench-warrant-list-released-by-the-bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-53/) (free lead)[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/30/tazewell-county-school-board-appoints-interim-member/) (free lead)

High school football: Graham 44, Tazewell 13; other regional scores include PikeView 41, Wyoming East 12.[[13]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/31/wvvas-football-friday-1030-part-one/)

**Region:** Small Business Administration loan program available for WV residents affected by August floods.[[11]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bench-warrant-list-released-by-the-bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-53/) (free lead)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Halloween trick-or-treat and events Saturday evening (core towns 6-8 p.m.).
- Mercer County Commission meeting Tuesday (includes trick-or-treat hours vote).
- Continued early voting through Monday; Election Day Tuesday.
- Tazewell County data center moratorium in effect; school board activities ongoing.
- No major weather or enforcement developments flagged.
